qualifying_findings.title: OpenAI reports Codex use shifting from short chat to delegated long-horizon work
qualifying_findings.short_factual_summary: OpenAI published an economic research summary describing Codex as a tool for delegated, longer-horizon tasks that orchestrate tools, environments, and iteration. It reports increasing Codex use across technical and non-technical departments, including many requests estimated to represent more than 30 minutes of human work.
qualifying_findings.why_it_matters_for_ai_assisted_developme: The local practice implication is that operating models need supervision, task slicing, progress visibility, and governance for multi-hour delegated work, not just prompt quality for single-turn coding help.

qualifying_findings.title: GitHub Copilot code review adds organization-level review depth visibility and CLI file tools
qualifying_findings.short_factual_summary: GitHub announced that Copilot code review can show Medium analysis attribution, support organization-level default review depth, and use built-in file exploration tools such as grep, rg, glob, and view in its review path. GitHub says the change reduced review costs while maintaining review quality in offline and online evaluation.
qualifying_findings.why_it_matters_for_ai_assisted_developme: AI review quality is becoming tied to explicit depth settings, source exploration tools, and measured cost-quality tradeoffs. Local review guidance can treat review depth and retrieval path as configuration surfaces rather than hidden model behavior.

qualifying_findings.title: Microsoft Agent Experience guidance covers agents working with technologies absent from model training
qualifying_findings.short_factual_summary: Microsoft published Agent Experience guidance for proprietary code, internal SDKs, and custom frameworks that models have not seen in training. It recommends baseline evaluations, layered teaching, concise instruction files for identity and conventions, MCP servers for current API surface, skills for workflows, reference implementations, and diagnostic error messages as teaching surfaces.

qualifying_findings.short_factual_summary: InfoQ reported examples from Uber, DoorDash, and Cloudflare where AI is used as a first-pass evaluation layer for product requirements, code review, security, performance, correctness, and design inputs. The article emphasizes human reviewers retaining final judgment and AI reducing low-signal review noise.
qualifying_findings.why_it_matters_for_ai_assisted_developme: The local pattern is continuous validation across software artifacts, not just post-code review. It supports local leaves about review gates, artifact-level evals, and high-signal AI review design.

qualifying_findings.title: Digital Applied summarizes agentjacking as an MCP-connected coding-agent trust-boundary risk
qualifying_findings.short_factual_summary: Digital Applied described agentjacking as an attack class where malicious instructions are hidden inside data an AI coding agent retrieves through an MCP-connected external service, such as an error report. The article frames defenses around MCP audits, sandboxing, deny-by-default egress, human approval for shell execution, secret rotation, and audit logging.
qualifying_findings.why_it_matters_for_ai_assisted_developme: The practice implication is that untrusted retrieved content must be treated as data, not authority. Prompt warnings alone are not sufficient; controls should constrain execution, egress, credentials, and MCP connection trust boundaries.

qualifying_findings.title: Microsoft describes agentic platform goals across planning, review, security, operations, and modernization
qualifying_findings.short_factual_summary: Microsoft described a Customer Zero series about applying agents across the software lifecycle. The article frames agentic platform goals around lifecycle rearchitecture, side-by-side collaboration, embedded security and governance, and developer experience. It also emphasizes clear specs as a source of truth for generation, verification, and operations.
qualifying_findings.why_it_matters_for_ai_assisted_developme: This supports local operating-model guidance where agents are embedded into platform workflows with shared specs, review, security, compliance, and operational feedback loops rather than used only as individual coding assistants.
